boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten named RWU study and academic-support environments, selected for documented space, research, technology, or tutoring affordances.

cards.title: Learning Commons
cards.subtitle: University Library
cards.notes: Set up here when you need a mix of individual and collaborative work, then use the library, technology, and academic-support services in the same building.
cards.short_summary: A library-based environment that combines study space with academic and technology support.
cards.evidence_claim: RWU describes the Learning Commons as integrating library resources, information technology, academic support, instruction, and collaborative and individual study space.
cards.source_title: About the Library | Roger Williams University
cards.access_notes: Located in the Main/University Library. Library facilities give precedence to RWU students, faculty, and staff.

cards.title: Architecture Library
cards.subtitle: Cummings School of Architecture
cards.notes: Bring a reading list or project file and choose individual or group seating; use the public computers, printers, and scanners when they fit your work.
cards.short_summary: A two-floor library with architecture-focused collections and work equipment.
cards.evidence_claim: RWU says the Architecture Library offers a quiet study space, public computers and scanners, plus individual or group seating free to the RWU community.
cards.source_title: More Than Books: 3 Lesser-Known Resources of RWU’s University Library
cards.access_notes: Located in the Cummings School of Architecture and open to the entire RWU community; check current library hours before going.

cards.title: Media Tech Center
cards.subtitle: University Library Learning Commons
cards.notes: Use this stop for a technology-heavy assignment, then ask the center for help with laptops, tablets, video cameras, repair, or technical questions.
cards.short_summary: A library-based technology-support point beside first-floor collaborative work areas.
cards.evidence_claim: RWU reports that the Media Tech Center provides private consultations on laptops, tablets, and video cameras, as well as repair and technical help.
cards.source_title: Meet the Learning Commons: A One-Stop Shop for Academic, Technology Needs
cards.access_notes: In the University Library’s Learning Commons; confirm service availability with Media Tech before planning a consultation.

cards.title: Library Information Center
cards.subtitle: University Library Learning Commons
cards.notes: Start a research session here when you need help locating a book or getting oriented to library resources before settling into nearby study space.
cards.short_summary: An on-site library help point integrated into the Learning Commons.
cards.evidence_claim: RWU identifies the Library Information Center as part of the Learning Commons integration and places it with expanded first-floor study areas.
cards.source_title: Meet the Learning Commons: A One-Stop Shop for Academic, Technology Needs
cards.access_notes: Located in the University Library; the library information desk lists phone, text, and email contact options.

cards.title: Tutoring Center
cards.subtitle: Second floor, Main Library
cards.notes: Bring a course question or draft and walk in for peer tutoring; schedule ahead if you need a faculty tutor or want a more focused session.
cards.short_summary: A second-floor academic-help environment with peer tutoring and study-group support.
cards.evidence_claim: RWU states that the Tutoring Center is on the second floor of the Main Library, offers peer tutors and specialized study groups, and is free.
cards.access_notes: Peer tutors accept walk-ins; faculty-tutor appointments are encouraged. The guide lists tutoring hours, but confirm schedules before visiting.

cards.title: Writing Center
cards.subtitle: Tutoring Center, second floor of Main Library
cards.notes: Use an in-person session to work through a writing assignment with a tutor; bring the prompt and current draft so the conversation can stay practical.
cards.short_summary: A named writing-support center within RWU’s Main Library tutoring hub.
cards.evidence_claim: RWU lists the Writing Center among the Tutoring Center’s component centers and directs students to visit it in person for in-person tutoring.
cards.access_notes: In-person help is at the Writing Center; the Tutoring Center is on the Main Library’s second floor and services are listed as free.

cards.title: University Archives
cards.subtitle: RWU University Library system
cards.notes: Plan a source-driven work session around campus, Bristol, or East Bay history and ask library staff about access to archival or special-collections materials.
cards.short_summary: A primary-source research destination for university and regional history.
cards.evidence_claim: RWU identifies University Archives as the official repository for the university and notes its Bristol and East Bay history holdings and Special Collections.
cards.access_notes: Contact University Archives through the University Library before a visit to confirm material access and any handling arrangements.

cards.title: Mary Tefft White Cultural Center
cards.subtitle: First floor, University Library
cards.notes: Check the library calendar before using this library-based room; when open, it is a named setting for talks, workshops, exhibitions, and academic events.
cards.short_summary: A first-floor University Library cultural and academic-programming room.
cards.evidence_claim: RWU places the Mary Tefft White Cultural Center on the first floor of the University Library and uses it for lectures, workshops, and exhibitions.
cards.source_title: Mary Tefft White Cultural Center | Roger Williams University
cards.access_notes: This is an event and exhibition space; availability for quiet work depends on the library’s current program schedule.

cards.title: Intercultural Center Multi-Purpose Room
cards.subtitle: Intercultural Center
cards.notes: Use the multi-purpose room for a change of setting, and check with the Intercultural Center if you need to reserve it or confirm student access.
cards.short_summary: A student-support space explicitly described by RWU as usable for studying.
cards.evidence_claim: RWU states that the Intercultural Center’s multi-purpose room is a place where students can study, socialize, unwind, build community, and get involved.
cards.access_notes: The university says the multi-purpose room is available for reserve or student use; check with the Intercultural Center for current availability.

cards.title: Law Library Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: RWU Law Library
cards.notes: Reserve a room when you need individual or group study space, and read the room policy before arriving so the reservation remains valid.
cards.short_summary: Reservable study rooms in RWU’s law-library setting.
cards.evidence_claim: RWU Law states that students can book Law Library study rooms for individual or group study sessions and directs users to follow the room policy.
cards.source_title: Exam Time Stress & Wellness | RWU Law
cards.access_notes: Room reservations are subject to the Law Library policy; confirm eligibility and reservation terms with the Law Library before booking.
